criteria_source: The fixture only. flags.js sends `Cache-Control: max-age=3600` as a request header, and response-headers.txt shows the shared cache returning a HIT with an age of 2841 seconds against an origin max-age of 30. Written from the client and the captured headers, not from rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when it identifies the `Cache-Control: max-age=3600` header that flags.js sends on the request as the cause: as a request directive it tells the shared cache in front of the flag service that a response up to an hour old is acceptable, which is why the cache serves a HIT with an age of 2841 seconds even though the origin sets max-age=30. Fails when it blames the 60-second in-process cache in flags.js, the origin's own cache-control, per-instance caches across service replicas that have not expired yet, clock skew, or slow propagation inside the flag service, or when it identifies no cause at all.
